scope: five new original tasks across three additional occupations; separate execution cohort
solver_context: fresh fork_turns=none per task; original prompt file unmodified; project rubrics and prior outputs prohibited

cost_note: No OpenRouter inference calls in this cohort. In-app model usage may consume subscription allowance; dollar cost unavailable, not zero. Existing $30 cap and all v2 reservations retained.

allowed_tools: v3 CLI over frozen v2 native writers; local code may prepare JSON and calculate but may not author outputs outside the native tool path; no external actions/browsing
image_receipts: explicit local view_image display acknowledgments, not provider delivery receipts
comparability: Do not pool with v2 or claim this isolates occupational difficulty. Provider, tool access, context and run limits differ.
